'''Sibar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] and a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Zabrak Army]] of [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]].

==Biography==
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Sibar and some other elite soldiers were hired by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]] [[Purton]] to kill the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. The [[Squad/Legends|squad]] failed and was later tracked by Fett. Sibar was finally killed on Iridonia.
